COMPUTER STUDIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Computer set up, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Computer set up.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer set up.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer set up.
